Viv: Heads-up  CloudMarket launch with SignalSI next month. We need a short, deterministic handoff rule for marketplace leads + SI intros so ops doesn't triage manually.
Diego: Proposal: 3 signals, precedence order: (1) partner intro tag + meeting within 10d -> SI owns, (2) marketplace utm + partner claimed in intake within 48h -> SI owns, (3) ARR >= $100k and not in proposal -> SI owns. Else Redwood owns.
Tasha: Add guardrails: if account.named=true or deal_stage>=proposal, block auto-reassign. Also partner intro tags expire after 21d of inactivity.
Matt: Dispute flow: claim->partnerships-bot posts to #partnerships-disputes with `dispute:open` tag, 24h SLA, escalate weekly if unresolved. Bot should write ownership_reason to CRM.
partnerships-bot: noted  will post disputes and set CRM field `ownership_reason`. :robot_face:
Viv: Implementation asks: intake API to accept `partner_claimed_by` and `partner_intro_tag`, plus webhook for utm payload. Ops will draft a short playbook and email intro template.
Diego: I'll sync with SignalSI to confirm triage SLA.
Tasha: No objections from ops.
Matt: LGTM from eng.
Viv: Locked. We'll pilot these rules for the launch and revisit after 2 weeks.
